string.name: about_privacy_body
string.value:
Current build: no account or cloud sync is used. Theme, language, and security preferences are stored locally on the device. Authenticator and vault entries shown in this preview are mock data.

Sensitive screens (Unlock, Authenticator, Vault, and Generator) block screenshots and screen recording. Onboarding, Settings, and About allow capture. If Hide recent-app preview is enabled, the window is protected while paused or hidden.

Values copied by TimeAuth are restricted to the local device. When automatic clipboard clearing is enabled, TimeAuth attempts to clear its own copied value after 30 seconds and will not clear newer clipboard content written by another app.

TimeAuth does not transmit these preferences or preview data to a TimeAuth server in the current build.

string.name: about_local_first_note
string.value: No account or cloud connection is required by the current build.
